notes.title: Update #106.1: Bug Fixes and New Features
notes.notes:
Hey Pinball Fans!


First of all, we’d like to say a huge thank you for all the feedback you’ve been sending us about the new menu. This project wouldn’t be possible without your support and input!

Today we’re rolling out a new update that fixes several issues and introduces some exciting new features. We’ve also started improving the Steam Deck view, making previously hidden or hard-to-see options more accessible. There’s still a long way to go to make the menu work perfectly across all views, so please keep sharing your bug reports with us. The fastest way is via our Discord channel, but you can also post them in the Steam Bug Report discussion.

Here’s what has changed so far:

Fixed an issue where switching to the next in-game camera with Steam Input didn’t work correctly.

Restored missing Glow Intensity Preset values in the graphics options.

Fixed error with custom tournaments showing “Not supported tournament type”.

Cabinet Mode is now properly disabled the DMD and backglass display in VR.

Fixed a bug where Replays sometimes appeared at 4th or 5th place instead of only for the top 3 scores.

Right mouse click functionality was added, so menus are now properly usable with mouse buttons only.

Fixed issues with the Hue Slider not working in certain places.

Certain sound effects (like plunger and some slingshots) now correctly respond to volume settings.

Additional music sound effects now scale with the Menu Music Volume setting.

Added a warning if Steam Input is enabled while using XInput (or vice versa).

If Steam Input is enabled, controller icons are now always displayed in the layout.

VR options now shows VR status and includes a Recenter button.

Added a Table View Size option.

Clicking the in-game camera icon with the mouse now properly switches to the next camera (just like pressing the C key).

Improved visibility of the main category navigation bar. Profile information has been repositioned to the bottom-left corner for better layout balance.

Increased the size of Store items for improved readability.

Fixed issues with long text strings in various languages (not all languages are fully revised yet, but readability has been greatly improved).

Updated the Tournament Leaderboard layout with a dedicated space for the replay button.

Of course, updates aren’t just about bug fixing we’ve also listened to your requests and brought new ways to play.

1-Ball Mode in Tournaments: Create intense single-ball tournaments (requires Bronze Pack) for faster, more exciting matches.

New Quest Types: Variety is the spice of pinball, so we’ve added new challenges:

Pass Score

Target Eliminator

Lamp Hunter

90 Sec Quests

Note: You must achieve the target score in a single game using these new quests.

We have increased the number of daily, weekly, and monthly quests. These changes will take effect from tomorrow.  

These new quest types are designed to keep you on your toes and make gameplay even more dynamic.

Finally, let’s talk about controls, because we know this is important for many of you. We’ve looked into Steam Input and XInput support, and here’s what you need to know:

Steam Input is usually enabled by default in Steam. If you want to use it, go to Zaccaria Pinball →  Controller Configuration (controller icon) and make sure Steam Input is active for our game. Also, choose the new controller layout, called “Zaccaria Pinball - New Version V2”. This layout fully supports the updated menu UI. In the game select Options → Controller settings, set the Controller Input Method to Steam Input. 

If you'd rather use XInput, you will need to disable Steam Input in the Steam client settings for our game. Then restart the game, and in the game select Options → Controller settings, set the Controller Input Method to XINPUT. Make sure your controller supports XInput natively.

Note: If we update or change the new layout, you will need to manually reapply the layout in order to receive those fixes.

We know this process can be a bit confusing. Unfortunately, because of how Steam handles controller abstraction on different platforms (especially Steam Deck), we can’t bypass some of these limitations. 

A small report for Mac users. We are currently investigating audio issues occurring on Mac. So far, our investigation points to a problem related to OpenAL support. We’re actively working on a solution and will update you as soon as a fix is available. 

Thank you again for your amazing support and enthusiasm. Updates like this are shaped by your feedback, and we can’t wait to hear what you think about these changes. Time to fire up the flippers and enjoy some pinball!



Happy flipping,
The Magic Pixel Team

notes.title: Update #106: A New Era, Star’s Phoenix Deluxe, Tournaments and more.
notes.notes:
Hey Pinball Fans! 



We’ve reached a huge milestone: after nine years of dedicated development and shared journey, Zaccaria Pinball is about to achieve what we dreamed of from the very beginning! This is not just an update. It marks the start of a new era in the life of the game.

When we first launched Zaccaria Pinball on Steam, it featured only 27 tables and very basic functionality. Back then, we could only hope that over time it would grow into a true pinball universe. Over the years, however, we shaped the game together with the community. Today, there are over 150 tables available, along with countless features that make the game unique in the world of digital pinball.

Back then, everything was different. Nine years ago, our goal was to make the game accessible to everyone, so we designed it to run even on 2010-era low/medium laptops. This meant that at the time, we couldn’t fully exploit the graphical capabilities of contemporary hardware.

The raytracing implementation in the game doesn’t require GPUs with dedicated raytracing cores. This was important to us because we wanted everyone to enjoy this graphical feature, not just those with the latest and most expensive GPUs. Nine years have passed, and today the minimum supported configuration is an NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030. Thanks to our long-standing development philosophy, even players with a GeForce GT 1030 can enjoy 1080p raytracing options. This GPU is already far more powerful than the originally targeted hardware.

Over the years, we’ve added VR support, multiplayer, major graphical upgrades and optimizations, and countless internal settings. All aimed at enhancing the gameplay experience. On multiple occasions, we rewrote the program almost entirely. In our current work, which began earlier this year, we’ve fundamentally redesigned the system again to ensure it remains stable, expandable, and enjoyable for many years to come.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/8ee56a2fb85fb64a6bc31e228277bd62f0c09b95.png"]

One of the biggest changes is that Zaccaria Pinball now runs on a server-based system, whereas previously it relied solely on Steam. We built this system completely from scratch. It wasn’t easy, but we believe this ensures a long-term, high-quality experience for the community and continuous growth of the game. This decision is also important because our priority has always been that players should not have to buy the content again as a new program. Tables you’ve acquired over the years will remain yours. We believe that community retention, respect for players, and shared experiences are far more important than any short-term revenue.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/2e784e7a3733a20ed3fa66404be3b0f0aee06a0a.png"]

From the very beginning, we also kept in mind players who don’t want to or for some reason cannot play in online mode. One real-life scenario we considered is this. A user plays on Steam Deck at home in online mode, then takes the game on a trip where no internet is available. That’s why we implemented a system where any earned customizations remain accessible offline. Once the player reconnects to the internet, the game automatically syncs their progress with our servers, ensuring they still receive the XP they earned.

Over a month ago, we launched the closed beta. Nearly 50 players enthusiastically supported our work. Countless bug fixes and gameplay improvements were made based on feedback and reports. This month felt long to us because every day brought us closer to sharing the game with a wider audience. It was a challenge to balance fixing bugs and implementing community suggestions, but we chose the latter to ensure a better experience for you.

We released the closed beta even though VR and multiplayer weren’t fully re-implemented yet, and the game could mostly only be controlled with a mouse. We sincerely thank the beta testers who spent countless hours testing the server-based system despite these limitations. Along the way, we also added new graphical enhancements. Opal lamps on original Zaccaria tables and 3D prism lamps now feature raytracing for a more lifelike look. Additionally, large pinball table lamps now behave like classic halogen bulbs. They gradually light up and fade, rather than just switching on and off. On older EM tables, Scroll Reels are now correctly simulated.

For an authentic experience, we implemented the Carry Over style, but because it can be slow in real life. Especially on retro tables with seven-digit scores. We also added the option to use Direct Drive. The main difference is that Carry Over only drives the first wheel, while the others follow. Whereas in Direct Drive, all wheels spin independently. The new customization menu lets you freely choose which style you prefer.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/65e35e2e159be7639b714d98f8107c1892227f6a.png"]

We’ve completely revamped customization in the game. There’s now a leveling system where you earn XP, unlocking new customization options as you level up. But that’s not all. As shown in earlier screenshots, there’s also a “Magic Market” menu. You might wonder if this requires real money. We managed to avoid microtransactions entirely! The solution is the Tournament system, which includes both official tournaments and player-organized events. Players who place well earn in-game currency, which can be spent in the Magic Market. Additionally, players who purchased the Bronze Pack receive extra customization options.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/a6e2d27737135fed731ec01a8786795d5076e91d.png"]

The new server-based system allowed us to completely redesign the Achievement system. From now on, in-game Achievements are called Table Tasks, with some still linked to their corresponding Steam Achievements. These Table Tasks are now also saved on our servers.

VR controls have been fully re-implemented, like all other features. You can now choose which eye is displayed on the player’s screen, and we’ve redesigned laser pointer handling, making aiming much more precise and easier for UI navigation. Additionally, FFR (Fixed Foveated Rendering) has been implemented. This keeps the center of your view sharp while gradually reducing detail toward the edges, improving VR performance with minimal impact on clarity. It requires an NVIDIA RTX graphics card.

We’ve updated Steam Input with new actions, which may require you to manually reselect your Steam Input settings. At the same time, we’ve kept the legacy XInput support. XInput button mappings can be adjusted in-game, while Steam Input customization is done through the Steam interface. It’s important to select the correct input method, as the two cannot be used simultaneously.

We also implemented the RCAS pass from FSR 1.0, often used by VR players for extra image sharpness. However, it’s available to all users with a stronger GPU and can be very useful.

Another new feature enabled by the server-based system is Quests. There are daily, weekly, and monthly Quests. Completing them grants XP, helping you level up.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/8ab2b2d126958e33a3f176459b26ff64c0643d2e.png"]

We’d like to introduce the Tournament system to help you understand why it was implemented this way. We aimed to recreate the atmosphere of real tournaments. Once a Tournament match starts, there are no breaks. You must complete it in one go. Every pinball hit matters, as official tournaments give a limited number of attempts. This ensures that every shot counts. Official Tournaments come in three types: daily, weekly, and monthly. Players who own the table get more attempts (3/4/5), while those who don’t still get 1/1/2 attempts. Owners can also practice in unlimited Practice mode before the match, following the same rules but without recording scores.

There’s also the Custom Tournament, which players can start for 100 Magic Coins. Up to nine Custom Tournaments can run simultaneously, and each player can host only one at a time. Settings are fully customizable: Arcade/Simulation/User(host physical parameters) mode, 3 or 5 balls, and number of attempts. Duration is limited to 24 hours. Winners of both Official and Custom Tournaments earn Magic Coins. If a Custom Tournament is successful, the host is refunded 100 Magic Coins. For detailed rules, please check the in-game description.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/3a53f859394df6202ceb35d2bf0dab445a6f3eb4.png"]

Recently, beta testers asked how we could better reward players who purchased content. The solution is profile customization. All players can earn XP and spend Magic Coins in the Magic Market, but the profile banner stripe is reserved for those who have purchased content. This way, everyone receives rewards, while supporting players are specially recognized.

Originally, completed Tournaments couldn’t be reviewed, as we were focused on making the system work correctly. Following beta feedback, we added this feature. At the last moment, we also re-implemented replay functionality. You can now watch matches of the top 3 players during the Tournament, and replays remain available for 30 days after completion.

Over the past year, we modified more than 40,000 lines of code in our massive 340,000-line engine/game codebase. Server-side code adds another 32,000+ lines. This doesn’t include third-party libraries.

We’re proud that, as a small but passionate and dedicated team, we could work on this project. We know many of you have been with us since the beginning, while others joined later. We sincerely thank all of you for your support, ideas, bug reports, and even criticism. Every piece of feedback helped us make the game better. There were tough times and forced breaks over these nine years, but we never gave up because we always felt it was worth continuing.

The version being released now is not the conclusion. It’s a new beginning. In the coming days, we’ll work on leaving Early Access. For us, leaving Early Access is just a milestone. We will continue developing Zaccaria with the same enthusiasm. We know this version isn’t perfect and never will be, but we strive to release the best version possible. We apologize in advance for any critical bugs you may encounter and will work to fix as many issues as possible.

After leaving Early Access, our next milestone is to have Zaccaria Pinball run as a unified version on all platforms (Nintendo, Android, iOS, PlayStation, Xbox), including shared Tournaments and Leaderboards. We hope this will finally create a true pinball universe where players can compete from anywhere.

We know that for veteran players, the new menu structure may feel a bit unfamiliar at first, as we completely redesigned it. Our goal was to create a logical layout that works seamlessly with every input method. We considered touch screens, keyboards, mice, controllers, and VR controls. Creating a menu that met all these criteria wasn’t easy, so in some areas, compromises were necessary. Please share your feedback to let us know if we succeeded. No matter how you play, the experience should remain enjoyable.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/6573249af1dad8d0ffb29ce62d8b60781992f709.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/300c8bb150d3f1614e81bf012eaf6abd9ea53369.png"]

From the very beginning, it has been our dream to make the game accessible to players who don’t speak English. With more customization options than ever before, supporting multiple languages became a crucial consideration during the rewrite. Accordingly, we designed the UI from the ground up to handle different languages. We’ve successfully translated the game into Hungarian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Russian, and Dutch. Special thanks go to the native-speaking beta testers who helped correct language errors. We know some inaccuracies may remain, so we ask native-speaking players to report any issues via bug tickets, and we will fix them. Please note that table rules and in-game DMD/LCD text are not included in the translations.

We felt that the original Artwork Table no longer met modern expectations, so we completely overhauled the Artwork DLC. The Artwork Table is replaced by the Viking Table, featuring deluxe-level table mechanics and a special ability. Before you start playing, you can customize its visuals.

This table includes 16 individually customizable elements, such as the cabinet interior walls, ramp plastics, pop bumper caps, targets, background, and main playfield components. For each element, you can choose from five different graphic styles, allowing for a unique visual experience every time you play. If you don’t want to spend too much time customizing, there’s also an option to generate a random setup.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/8b9d03916a7581215fba2f697d09b9bdca5c1b2d.gif"]



This year, every update has included a new table, and this update is no exception.

Step up and feel the heat. Star’s Phoenix Deluxe takes the legendary 1987 classic and turns it into a high-roller’s dream. Dazzling visuals, fast-paced action, and nonstop rewards bring the thrill of the casino floor straight to your screen.

Spin the reels of chance with ball save, kickback, multipliers, and sizzling combo shots, then stack up the wins with skillshots, hand bonuses, jackpots, and exclusive access to the VIP poker room and cocktail bar.

Choose your game of chance across five unique modes (Poker, Craps, Blackjack, Baccarat, and Roulette) each packed with its own casino-inspired challenges and risks worth taking. And when the stakes skyrocket, unleash multiball madness and chase layered objectives that keep the adrenaline flowing.

With every flip, Star’s Phoenix Deluxe captures the glamour, glitz, and energy of a luxury casino. Reimagined for the digital pinball age. Place your bets, hit the lights, and let the good times roll.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/0b2355d063cb010b1fb4d2d83b4b0ded5f5d3613.gif"]

And that’s not all. We’re also preparing a special surprise, which we’re keeping under wraps for now. But one thing’s for sure. Pinball fans will want to keep an eye out!

We are deeply grateful for your support throughout this long journey. Without you, this game could never have become what it is today. A constantly expanding pinball experience with over 150 tables, offering challenges for every type of player.

Now it’s time to celebrate together. Zaccaria Pinball has finally reached its best form yet.

For those who love a great soundtrack, the awesome music tracks from this new table are available separately if you own the Zaccaria Pinball - Original Soundtrack DLC. 

We hope everyone enjoys the new version, and we thank you for continuing to be part of our journey!



Happy flipping,
The Magic Pixel Team

notes.title: Update #105: Time Machine Deluxe, LCD upgrades & exciting news hit this update!
notes.notes:
Hey Pinball Fans! 



Happy Thursday's update! Today we bring you another Deluxe table, LCD updates for more Deluxe tables, and some exciting news about the new iteration. Let’s dive into the details.

Our mission to add improved LCD animations to all Deluxe tables has officially reached its conclusion. From now on, every Deluxe table includes the upgraded LCD display with enhanced visuals and animations.

Today’s update adds the new LCD animations to the following tables:

Robot Deluxe

Combat Deluxe

Farfalla Deluxe

Space Shuttle Deluxe

Zankor Deluxe

We hope you enjoy the new look and feel across the entire Deluxe lineup!

We’re also excited to share that the new system has reached the stage where we can launch a closed beta test. This new interface includes groundbreaking features and a fresh user experience that we can't wait for you to explore.

Interested in joining the beta? You can apply now on Discord.

Please note: This is the final update for the “old” iteration. All future updates will support the new system only.

Now let's talk about the new table.

...Wait, is this now? Or then? Or perhaps still to come?

Somewhere between last week’s echoes and tomorrow’s code, a new Deluxe Table materialized.

Originally from 1983… or was it 2025? It’s hard to tell when the flippers spin across centuries. The Time Machine is now reborn as the Time Machine Deluxe table. This table launches you into the past, present, and future, with ball saves, kickbacks, multipliers, combos, and curious powers like Future Boost and Time Warp.

Complete eight main missions, (each representing a letter of “TIMELINE”) and chase strange phenomena like Paradox, Continuum, Chronology, and Wormhole. Every shot brings a twist in time.

Become the master of timeline now.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/9981e7f9d4067e02a5180bac8d33982adc65f694.gif"]



For those who love a great soundtrack, the awesome music tracks from this new table are available separately if you own the Zaccaria Pinball - Original Soundtrack DLC. 

As always we appreciate your unbroken support towards our work!



Happy flipping,
The Magic Pixel Team

notes.title: Update #104: Granada Deluxe lands with fresh LCD upgrades and Early Access news
notes.notes:
Hey Pinball Fans! 



Welcome to another Thursday update! Today, we bring you a brand-new Deluxe table. Following our recent fiesta in Mexico, we’re now sailing across the Atlantic straight into the heart of Andalusia.

We’re continuing our mission to upgrade LCD animations for earlier Deluxe tables. This time, four more have received the treatment: Strike Deluxe, Universe Deluxe, Pool Champion Deluxe, and House of Diamonds Deluxe. These visual LCD upgrades aim to enhance your gameplay experience and keep the Deluxe lineup feeling fresh and unified.

But before we talk more about the new table, we want to update you. We’re still working hard on the new iteration of Zaccaria Pinball. Internal testing went well, but there are still a few missing features and some stubborn bugs we need to finish baking before we can share it with you. We’re already on the home stretch! Please note that, once we exit Early Access, prices will increase. The game will remain free to play, but this DLC price adjustment is necessary to support future growth.

Now, onto the table.

Granada Deluxe invites you to the heart of southern Spain, where vibrant rhythms echo through cobbled streets, and ancient architecture tells tales of a rich and layered history. Just like the city itself, the table is a feast of color, energy, and surprises from the ornate towers of the Cathedral multipliers, to the sizzling tension of the Paella Bonus.

You’ll roam local markets, battle bulls in thrilling pop bumper challenges, and spin your way through bubbling fountains as you chase jackpots and mini games across two dynamic upper playfields. Whether you’re lighting the WAY, unlocking the CITADEL, or gathering ingredients in culinary-themed game modes like Soup, Spices, and Spicy Cake, Granada Deluxe is packed with personality and scoring potential.

Let the music guide you, light the T-E-A and S-P-A lamps for ball saves, and don’t forget to stir the pot, because this table rewards strategy, timing, and flair.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/c96484f0dbc2838b9cfd93c1da4fd79fa0ec691d.gif"]



For those who love a great soundtrack, the awesome music tracks from this new table are available separately if you own the Zaccaria Pinball - Original Soundtrack DLC. 



A big thank you, as always, for your continued support and feedback.



And one more thing. Want to see Granada Deluxe in action? 

Duveline will be live-streaming the table today on Twitch at 9 PM CEST.

Watch it here: [dynamiclink href="https://twitch.tv/duveline"][/dynamiclink]



Happy flipping,
The Magic Pixel Team

notes.title: Update #103: Mexico Deluxe debuts with vibrant play and LCD animation upgrades
notes.notes:
Hey Pinball Fans! 



It’s Thursday again! Right before the Steam Summer Sale, we dropped an update to keep things moving. Now that the sale is almost over, we’re back with another one to spark your flippers with fresh energy! This week, you can expect exciting refinements alongside a vibrant new culinary-themed table that’s sure to add flavor and flair to your collection.



As promised in our last update, we’ve upgraded the LCD animations on several Deluxe tables from the pre‑2025 era, bringing them up to the vivid visual standard first introduced with Tropical Deluxe. Red Show Deluxe, Cine Star Deluxe, and Spooky Deluxe now shine with renewed energy, and updated typefaces are on the way to complete their transformation. 



We’ve also refreshed the typefaces on the tables from our previous update, creating a more consistent and polished experience across the entire Deluxe lineup.

Expect richer visual feedback and smoother animations during your combos and multiballs!



Work is progressing on the new iteration of Zaccaria Pinball, and if all goes according to plan, internal testing will begin next week. The team is excited to take this important step forward, and we can't wait to share more as development continues.
This milestone is another move toward leaving Early Access. Get ready for exciting new features, as the fresh look will come with new functionalities as well. Please note that, once we exit Early Access, prices will increase. The game will remain free to play, but this DLC price adjustment is necessary to support future growth.



And now let's continue with the new table.

¡Señoras y señores! The moment you have been waiting for has arrived.

Under the glow of flickering candlelight and the sway of vibrant decorations, Mexico Deluxe unleashes its fiesta energy on your playfield. Striking the flippers sends combos pulsing like celebratory drumbeats, while swift kickbacks and Multiball erupt in a whirlwind of color and sound. Every flick echoes the joy of a festival, as you chase the Fest Bonus and surge toward Carnival Mode. That captures the heart of this joyous celebration.

¡Viva la diversión!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/2e7cf950f1f06eda18b14b7802f5c5c35a256b9d.gif"]

For those who love a great soundtrack, the awesome music tracks from this new table are available separately if you own the Zaccaria Pinball - Original Soundtrack DLC. 



Thank you all for your continued support and feedback. We love refining, expanding, and celebrating the Deluxe experience with you. See you courtside in Mexico Deluxe, flip true, chase glory, and keep that nostalgia alive.

¡Muchas gracias! For your continued support and feedback.



Happy flipping,
The Magic Pixel Team

notes.title: Update #102: Star God Deluxe Arrives and Brings New DMD Animations
notes.notes:
Hey Pinball Fans!


It’s Thursday, and that means a brand-new update has landed in Zaccaria Pinball! We're continuing our 2025 mission to polish, expand, and celebrate the Deluxe lineup. This time, it's all about dazzling animations and a brand-new cosmic adventure.



But before we kneel before the gods of flippers, here’s what’s new.

Improved DMD Animations have now been bestowed upon three more tables: 

Blackbelt Deluxe

Earth Wind Fire Deluxe

Future World Deluxe

These tables, originally released in early 2025, now shine with the same vibrant animation style first seen in Tropical Deluxe.  We’re planning to bring these updates to Deluxe tables released before 2025 in upcoming updates!



We’re also hard at work on the brand-new menu system, designed for better usability and a cleaner look. More on that soon!



And now... a new challenge descends from the heavens.



Your fate lies written among the stars.



Where the sun rises with a rumble and serpents guard forgotten gates, Star God Deluxe awaits your challenge. Will you rise to meet him?



This epic table blends fast-paced combos, mystical bonuses, and layered playfield quests across two worlds. Survive the Snake Combo, ascend to the Second Playfield, and unlock the Big Blue Bonus. Master ten Game Modes, slay bumpers, conquer ramps, and chase down super jackpots from the mouth of cosmic serpents.


The stars are watching. Glory awaits.
Flip true... and become legend.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/75bb867390c21f9ac3a2849af96ae47cac7944cc.gif"]



For those who love a great soundtrack, the awesome music tracks from this new table are available separately if you own the Zaccaria Pinball - Original Soundtrack DLC. 



Thank you for your continued support and feedback. See you in the next update!



Happy flipping,
The Magic Pixel Team

notes.title: Update #101: Clowns have entered the ring!
notes.notes:
Hey Pinball Fans!


Happy Thursday!



The tent is up, the lights are flashing, and the playfield is prepped, it’s showtime under the big top!

While we’re still hard at work behind the scenes with ongoing improvements and developments, this week we’re unleashing a table that’s anything but subtle.

It’s loud, it’s colorful, and it’s here to turn your playfield into a carnival of chaos.


Ladies and Gentlemen, Boys and Girls - step right up!

Grab your popcorn and prepare yourselves for a spectacle like no other!

Tonight’s main attraction? A dazzling display of mayhem and madness we call... Clown Deluxe!



Enter a twisted circus where chaos is king and clowns are absolutely everywhere. Juggle multiballs through tight ramps, dive into the funhouse, and trigger silly sound effects with every flip. 

Expect honking horns, wild dancing, and surprises that hit like a pie to the face.

Multiballs pop like popcorn, and the clowns? They’re just one bumper away from total madness.


The show’s about to begin… and you’re the main event.


Can you master the madness, or will the clown have the last laugh?



Grab your tickets, tilt if you dare, and flip your way to center stage…

Because the circus just got Deluxe.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/ff7d653ff791cea3d0a04d7692639a1aa95a5554.gif"]

For those who love a great soundtrack, the awesome music tracks from this new table are available separately if you own the Zaccaria Pinball - Original Soundtrack DLC. 

A few words about the new menu and in-game coins.
We’ve seen some confusion about the new coins, so let’s clarify a few things without spoiling the surprise.

First and foremost: coins are not required to start a table, and they never will be. The current game start, trial system, and all the ways you enjoy your tables today will remain completely unchanged. You’ll still have free access to your purchased content, as always.

The new coins are tied exclusively to upcoming features. Think of them more like a bonus system, not a barrier. These coins cannot be bought with real money, and they are not used to unlock tables. They’re just a fun, earned currency to enhance your experience in new ways. If you take a close look at the image we shared, you might even spot a few hints about where they'll be used.

And no, you can’t buy love with them, but we hope you’ll love what you can get with them.

So don’t worry Zaccaria remains Zaccaria. We're just adding something new for those who want more to discover.



And here's a fun milestone with this update #101, Zaccaria Pinball has officially reached 2GB in size!

Hard to believe, right? Who would've thought you could squeeze this much fun into a space smaller than:

A 20-minute 4K funny animal video compilation.

Two full episodes of your favorite TV drama in HD resolution.

Half a DVD.

The maximum capacity of a top-tier hard drive in 1992.

Approximately 1325 floppy disks (that is around 25 kg or 55 lbs) for those keeping score in 1989.

And just how long would it take to download these glorious 2 gigabytes of pinball?

With modern 5G technology (1000 Mbps), it can be downloaded in just 16 seconds. That's about four blinks of an eye on an average day. 

On a modern fiber connection (100 Mbps), it takes about 3 minutes, barely enough time to grab a snack.

You might wait half an hour with ADSL.

Make yourself comfortable if you use the ISDN line (128 kbps). It'll take about 36 hours. Perfect for a weekend getaway.

Settle in for a 4-day download marathon on a good old 56k dial-up modem and don't pick up the phone!

Not bad for something packed with decades of pinball magic, hundreds of tables, and enough flashing lights to make a disco jealous.



Thank you for your continued support and feedback. See you in the next update!


Happy flipping,
The Magic Pixel Team

notes.title: Update #100 – Magic Castle Deluxe & Beyond
notes.notes:
Hey Pinball Fans!

Happy Thursday! We’re back with a fresh update to keep your flippers warm and your scores climbing!

Over the past few months our team has been split into three groups (table design, new Zaccaria features / bug fixing and a secret project). Now, that secret project and the main Zaccaria development have been merged, so you won’t see any extra surprises in this update, but rest assured our table-making crew is still working at full tilt!

The latest addition to our Deluxe series is Magic Castle Deluxe table, which invites you to a legendary pinball quest set in a mystical, alternate-medieval kingdom. Uncover hidden dungeons beneath the castle, and face off against mythical beasts and dragons. Master the enchanted ramps, trigger modes, and harness multiballs as you ascend through the castle’s secrets. Are you ready to wield the flippers of fate and become the ultimate Pinball Wizard?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/1f66a0fae7467ca371028b3d30cf5772666781f5.gif

For those who love a great soundtrack, the awesome music tracks from this new table are available separately if you own the Zaccaria Pinball - Original Soundtrack DLC.

And now, here comes the surprise. This is our 100th Steam update. Originally, we’d planned to mark this milestone with a brand-new beginning, as we hinted back in January. Earlier this year, we made a bold decision and completely rewrote the bulk of the Zaccaria codebase to lay down a modern, scalable, rock-solid foundation. This under-the-hood overhaul means we will be able to develop more efficiently going forward.

This will also mark the 5th major iteration of Zaccaria Pinball in its twelve-year lifespan. Sadly, we are not quite ready to publish this new iteration yet, but we see the light at the end of the tunnel.

The initial version launched on iOS on March 27, 2013, with just three tables: Time Machine, Locomotion, and Devil Riders.

We want to thank everyone who has been with us since the beginning.

Our Steam release went live on June 16, 2016, with 38 tables. This milestone would not have been possible without you, since we first had to get through Steam Greenlight (we submitted on Jan 21, 2016). After six months on Greenlight, we launched in Early Access, which gave us the opportunity to refine the game and add even more content for pinball fans.

Hard to believe, but the first version of Zaccaria Pinball didn’t include any achievements. On Jul 15, 2016 It was our 3rd update that introduced achievements for just three tables: Time Machine, Locomotion, and Devil Riders. Today, we have around 5,000 Steam achievements. Just four months later, on October 17, 2016, VR support was introduced. Then, one month after that, on November 18, 2016, we released our 30th update, which marked the beginning of new table content additions. We implemented real-time ray-traced shadows on December 16, 2016, with our 33rd update as an 'early Christmas present.' The feature even worked in the VR version. This was almost two years ahead of the RTX era and well before ray tracing became a defining feature in modern gaming.

Each update includes numerous bug fixes. The list goes on and on. If you'd like more details, please check the News section.

Now, after the 100th update, Zaccaria Pinball boasts 160 tables. That means 122 brand-new creations added over nearly nine years of development. Breaking it down, we’ve released at least one fresh table every month on average, even though we had a few years development gap.

This new iteration retains our entirely custom-developed game and physics engine, along with the familiar Zaccaria gameplay, making it feel like you’ve stepped into “Zaccaria Pinball 2”. Importantly, the new in-game coins can only be earned through play and cannot be purchased with real money. Plus, every achievement you have earned, every high score you have posted, and every DLC you have bought stays safe and sound!

Without saying any more, we're leaking a picture of the new look that speaks for itself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/b509cf3d8d642b6544b9a05a61c7b96f6cc2c2ec.jpg
This is a development preview of a possible future look.

After we release this 5th iteration, Zaccaria Pinball will step out of Early Access and become a full, finished game.

This milestone means we’ve crafted a version of Zaccaria Pinball that reaches the same level of completeness as the classic games of the ’90s. Back then there were no patches and what shipped was truly the final product. It was not only a golden era for video games but also for pinball itself. A time when machines stood proudly in arcades and perfection was built right into the glass and steel. We respect that legacy and we’re proud to deliver a game we can finally call “done”. That is the very reason we have spent so long in Early Access. “Done” doesn’t mean the end of content. It marks the beginning of a new phase, built on solid ground, much like the expansion packs of the past.

We’ll be leaving behind an important milestone, but that does not mean we’re done developing.

We’re continuously working to eliminate bugs and improve your gameplay experience. Check out our dedicated Bug Reports discussion for detailed info on the fixes.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. See you in the next update!

Happy flipping,
The Magic Pixel Team

notes.notes:
Hey Pinball Fans!

We’re back with another exciting update a little earlier than usual!
Due to a national holiday in Hungary, this week’s update drops one day ahead of schedule. We didn’t want you to wait any longer than necessary for the latest features and fixes!

Let’s kick things off with the technical improvements.

We’ve tackled a few important issues reported by the community:

 OpenGL version fallback function fix. After introducing FSR, we updated the OpenGL version from 3.3 to 4.5. Unfortunately, the fallback mechanism didn’t work as expected, leading to crashes for some players using older hardware.
 Improved Display Mode setting. In some scenarios, the Display Mode setting wasn’t functioning correctly, which could lead to display and performance issues. We've reworked the behavior for greater consistency and fewer surprises.
 The drivers will now prioritize stronger GPUs by default for Zaccaria. This resolves the issue where the game could automatically run on a weaker (integrated or energy-saving) graphics card, particularly affecting laptop users.
 Improved screen handling for cabinet users. It is now possible to assign the 4th display as a playfield, dmd, or backglass screen within the existing cabinet setup options. 
 Award Table Improvements. Starting from the City Golf Award table, we’ve begun systematically fixing bugs and polishing the Award series tables. These updates address long-standing issues and improve gameplay quality across the board. Expect more consistency and a better overall experience as we refined these special tables.
 Memory leak mitigation. We've significantly reduced the occurrence of a previously reported memory leak. While not fully eliminated yet, the issue no longer leads to crashes or instability during typical use. In internal testing, even after 80 table launches, no critical problems were observed.

While we’ve resolved many bugs in this update, a few known issues remain that we’re actively working on. These only occur when using Borderless Display Mode:

 on PC – When AMD Virtual Super Resolution (VSR) is enabled, activating a backglass or DMD screen in Cabinet Mode can cause the playfield resolution to exceed the screen’s boundaries.

Wild, just like your teenage spirit.

This is your table, your world. No limits, just raw energy and endless action. So grip it and flip it. Because if you’re not flipping… you're not really living.

For those who love a great soundtrack, the awesome music tracks from these new tables are available separately if you own the Zaccaria Pinball - Original Soundtrack DLC.

And a special surprise is not to be missed.

A small part of our dev team has been focused on reimagining how we present Zaccaria Pinball to the world, building a cleaner, more modern, and easy to navigate platform, not just for the game, but online too.

We're happy to announce that the official Zaccaria Pinball website is now live!

Got thoughts on the new site? We’d love your feedback! Drop a comment below or join the conversation on our forums.

…. and the last agenda item of the day is some clarification on Steam Achievements.

We’d like to clear up some confusion regarding our Steam achievements for the community as things have changed recently and we've found that there's a lot of misunderstanding.

Due to Steam’s technical limitation on the number of achievements allowed per game, we were forced to make a tough decision. In order to add new achievements for upcoming tables, we had to remove a portion of the existing ones.

But don’t worry, your progress will not be lost, only transformed.

Here’s how it works right now:

All achievements you’ve earned on Steam and not deleted will remain visible on in-game. But this achievement list may change in the future. The removed achievements (let’s temporarily call them Table Tasks) are still stored locally on your device, but they are separate progress from Steam. The Table Tasks are not erased, as long as you don’t delete your local save data. The Achievements menu in each table opens an Achievements List that currently displays a mix of both Steam achievements and the Table Task.

This system is still evolving and we intend to move the Table Tasks to an online-based tracking system, so they’re preserved independently from local files. But for now, as long as you keep your local game data, everything you’ve unlocked, both Steam achievements and Table Tasks will remain just like before.

Thanks as always for your support and whether you're hunting Easter eggs or high scores, we hope this update brings you a basket full of fun.

Happy flipping,
The Magic Pixel Team

notes.title: Devlog Update: Tackling Multi-Screen and macOS Issues
notes.notes:
Hey Pinball Fans!

We value your support and feedback, and we want you to know that we’re actively ironing out issues to deliver the best possible pinball experience.

We’ve fixed a crash issue that was affecting some players using multiple screens. After a lot of investigation, we discovered that the problem was related to how the Steam overlay interacts with the game. It wasn’t easy to track down, but the issue has now been resolved. We also addressed a similar problem on macOS. The fix will be included in Thursday’s update.

Thank you for your patience and support as we continue improving the game!

If you're curious about what caused these issues and how we fixed them, we’d love to share a bit more detail. It turned out to be a deceptively simple problem with a not-so-simple solution, and we had to get a little creative to work around it. Here's what happened behind the scenes:

Some of you have reported crashes on setups with a second or third screen. After a thorough investigation, we discovered that the underlying problem was very simple. In addition to this, we want to be transparent about our development process. We do not use the Steam version of our build during development, which meant that we didn’t catch this issue early on. It was only once players experienced the game on Steam that we were able to identify and address the problem.

Steam overlays its interface without distinguishing between the main game window and additional ones. This means that every time our game refreshed the content on any window, the overlay reinitialized itself. This constant reinitialization was causing a memory leak in the Steam overlay’s implementation.

However, the solution to this issue was far from straightforward. With no available API from Steam to restrict or manage the overlay’s behavior, our team had to think outside the box. Instead of refreshing the content on the second and third windows, we reverted to a legacy OpenGL function that updates the content without triggering a full screen refresh. In doing so, we moved away from using double buffering for these additional windows. Instead, we adopted a single buffer setup. By avoiding the full screen refresh altogether, we stopped the overlay from repeatedly reinitializing and switching windows, effectively preventing the memory leak.

We also identified an issue affecting our macOS users. Our Metal implementation was not handling external displays correctly. Since we develop on a MacBook Air (M1, 2020) without an external display, we had only been verifying the built-in screen. 

Meanwhile, we saw a memory leak problem in our macOS implementation.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/97e858d8cd95b61f8d775a3f95e8617cf16e7023.png
This fix was not easy, as it involved debugging across multiple programming languages (C++ and Objective-C). Once we identified the root cause, we were able to address the issue successfully.

Happy flipping,
The Magic Pixel Team

notes.title: Update #94: LCD Video Animation, Tropical Deluxe & Boxing Club Arrive!
notes.notes:
Hey Pinball Fans!

Over the past two weeks, we've been hard at work to bring you another fantastic update. Our team has been busy delivering fresh content, cool new features, and plenty of bug fixes to enhance your gameplay experience.

Good news for AMD video card users: we've eliminated the occasional crash issue that some of you experienced.

For those with multi-screen setups, we've resolved issues related to multiple displays, ensuring a smoother experience across the board.

As usual, we're expanding our table selection with two new pinball tables.

First, the Tropical Deluxe table adds a vibrant twist to our Deluxe series. This table gives you a taste of summer on a tropical island. Plus, for the first time, we've introduced video animation on the LCD display!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/59b03c94baed521372aa73c8655c5d394134477b.gif

Next, the Boxing Club table joins our Award series, offering a punchy, unique theme that's sure to stand out. Originally developed for mobile platforms back in 2012, it's available to play for free after reaching 2200 achievements. And if you'd rather skip the grind, you can purchase the "Achievement Table Pack" to jump right into the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/2ac632392bbeb92054864de48cbc87e9cd07278c.gif

We've also polished the LCD display on Deluxe tables. From now on, each upcoming table will feature unique font types. You can try out the effect by navigating to Options > Table Skin > LCD Effect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/9b18580d3b69b577a5ff67381eb5a5077df549bc.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/58a7634ad2efe524fb07f527b0928f81cfef1b1a.gif

The soundtrack has been updated with the latest table music to perfectly complement the new vibes.

Thank you for your continued support and for being an awesome part of our community!

Happy flipping,
The Magic Pixel Team

notes.title: Update #93 - Journey Through Time: New Tables and a Thrilling Game Mode!
notes.notes:
Hey Pinball Fans!

Over the past two weeks, we’ve been hard at work to bring you another exciting update. We're thrilled to share that this update comes packed with fresh content for you to enjoy.

Just like in our previous updates, we're adding two new tables to the mix.

First up in our Deluxe series is the Earth Wind Fire Deluxe table. This table offers a fantasy theme that will enchant you with its magical gameplay elements. For the first time, we’ve introduced a decorative element featuring a black cat that watches the ball’s movement. Keep your eye on it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/45a4a3947fb15d2858dcd1e427f64fd7e92c2320.gif

Next, our new Award table takes you on a journey to mystic Egypt, where ancient secrets and intriguing challenges await. Originally developed for mobile platforms back in 2013, it’s available to play for free after reaching 2000 achievements. And if you’d rather skip the grind, you can purchase the "Achievement Table Pack" to jump right into the game.

But that’s not all. We’re also excited to introduce a brand-new game mode called Time Loop. We dreamed up this game mode back in the 2000s. After the 2010, we brought basic elements like rewind and slowdown to mobile players for Age of Pinball. Now, we’ve polished these elements and created this new game mode.

Within Time Loop, the Time Warp feature temporarily slows down the action, giving you extra control and precision during gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/dfce0dd0b8d19a00e66b625e241723306ee30d91.gif

Another exciting feature is Reverse Flow, which rewinds time by two seconds, giving you the chance to correct mistakes. However, be warned the ball will behave differently, as if you’re entering a completely different timeline.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/e56ccb2bbd1bbcba7b6b85485312d36606dbb4bc.gif

This new game mode is available on every pinball table, and there’s even a dedicated leaderboard for those competitive races. This extra content is available to everyone who owns the tables. Please note that the games in the Extra menu do not support this new mode.

Lastly, this update also includes various bug fixes to enhance your overall experience.

We hope you enjoy all the new contents and improvements this update brings!

And we haven't forgotten the OST as the last time. The OST has been updated with the music tracks of the latest tables.

Happy flipping,
The Magic Pixel Team

notes.title: Update #92
notes.notes:
Hey Pinball Fans!

Over the past two weeks, we’ve been hard at work on the latest Zaccaria Pinball update. We’re excited to share that this update includes several important bug fixes that have eliminated instability issues affecting some users. For example, we’ve resolved the problem where a black screen would appear forever during loading and the game would not continue, or where the Postal Redux Deluxe table would freeze during a random load. These fixes have greatly increased overall stability.

In addition to these fixes, we’ve implemented about 60 different bug fixes.

We’re also expanding our table lineup with two brand-new additions!

First up is the Future World Deluxe table. This new entry in our Deluxe series transports you to a futuristic, distant realm where you can explore new dimensions of the cosmic environment. Get ready to experience a whole new level of pinball action!

Next, we’re excited to introduce the City Golf table from our Award series, originally developed for mobile platforms back in 2013. As the name suggests, this table takes you to a vibrant golf course setting. It’s available to play for free after reaching 1800 achievements. And if you’d rather skip the grind, you can purchase the "Achievement Table Pack" to jump right into the game. This update brings back the nostalgic atmosphere of the early mobile days for our longtime fans.

We also have significant improvements on one of our classic Remake tables, Shooting the Rapids. Originally released back in 2016, this table has received a major visual and technical upgrade. We’ve optimized its decorative elements by increasing the polygon count and rethinking the design details, ensuring they better reflect the spirit of the original concept. Back then almost a decade ago we had to compromise on quality to support low-end devices. Today, we can now boldly enhance the visuals while still keeping the game accessible to everyone.

Here's a preview image that highlights the improvements made to the Shooting the Rapids remake table for easy comparison.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25288195/7de8529cb23e088cef3a00583c931648e807c0ad.jpg

Thank you for your unwavering support.

Happy flipping,
The Magic Pixel Team

notes.title: Update #91.1 - Longstanding AMD Crash on Windows Platform

Thank you so much for sticking with us and being such an amazing part of this journey.

Happy flipping,
The Magic Pixel Team

notes.title: Update #91
notes.notes:
Hey Pinball Fans!

Wow, it’s been a while. Two years and four months, to be exact. But we’re finally back, and we have so many exciting updates to share with you! Thank you for sticking with us during the long break. We’ve been hard at work behind the scenes, and now it’s time to show you everything we’ve been working on.

First up, we’re thrilled to introduce the Blackbelt Deluxe table! This brand-new addition is packed with action and designed to keep you flipping for hours of fun.

But that’s just the beginning. If you own the Retro Pack DLC, we have a special surprise for you. We’ve added 13 new retro tables to your collection at no extra cost! Your pinball lineup just got a massive boost with even more classic gameplay to enjoy.

And there’s more. We’ve gone the extra mile and completely overhauled the 27 existing retro tables. Instead of reusing the original art, we’ve created brand-new graphics that give these timeless classics a fresh, vibrant style. It’s the same retro gameplay you love, but now with a modern and polished look.

Still with us? Great, because here’s another big update. We’ve also revamped the 13 existing Deluxe tables with brand-new visuals. These updates bring a consistent and refined style to the Deluxe collection, making them even more immersive and exciting to play.

And now for the best news of all!

We’ve also updated the Remake tables, giving them the same treatment as the Deluxe tables. The remakes now feature a modern, consistent art style that no longer uses the original artwork from their Solid-State and Electro-Mechanical counterparts. The only things they share with the originals are their themes and names. Everything else has been completely reimagined. This is a massive transformation, and we can’t wait for you to experience it.

We almost forgot to mention. We’ve replaced the music in both Red Show Deluxe and Spooky Deluxe! The new tracks are from the same composer who created the music for the Blackbelt Deluxe table. Get ready for a fresh, exciting soundtrack that will elevate your gameplay experience even more!

We encourage you to revisit every Remake, Retro, and Deluxe table. The changes are huge, and we’re confident you’ll love the fresh new look!

We hope you’re as excited as we are to jump back into Zaccaria Pinball with all these incredible updates. Thank you for being such an amazing community. Your support means so much to us. Now, grab those flippers, rack up some high scores, and let us know what you think.

Finally, stay tuned. We have big plans for this year and can’t wait to share them with you! We are committed to working with the same energy and dedication as we did in the past. Our goal is to bring back the excitement of regular updates, just like the good old days.

And one last thing…

We’ve rewritten our engine to support the Metal API under macOS, along with native ARM support. 

For our Linux fans, we’ve fixed the AMD graphics issue, which also resolves the Steam Deck problem. Make sure to run Zaccaria Pinball with Steam Linux Native 1.0 (scout) to access the native implementation. Without this, Zaccaria Pinball will not run.

Additionally, we’ve fixed the VR implementation. It now works seamlessly with the Oculus Quest 3 via Steam Link. A small note: if you modify the eye resolution in the Steam interface, you will need to restart Zaccaria Pinball for the changes to take effect.

Happy flipping,
The Magic Pixel Team

This update is special indeed! The new Star God remake table has arrived! notes.title: Status Update for Linux version
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25288195/98444b875747d8dcb8753703165fdd56a363d5b1.png

First of all, we would like to apologize for the last update that made Zaccaria Pinball unplayable for some players on Linux.

In the last few weeks, we have worked on solving those issues. As a result of these fixes, we have to modify the minimum requirements for Linux players. Starting from Update #68, Linux players will require at least Ubuntu version 16.04 to play with Zaccaria Pinball.

Because SteamVR got updated in the past we also now have to make changes and update the game.

The current version of SteamVR library requires GCC version 4.9. 

However, Ubuntu 14.04 repository still includes version GCC 4.8. Because the game always loads the VR library GCC 4.9 has to be installed from the source if you want to play on 14.04.

Also, we made a GUI for dependencies so you can see what's missing.

See the sample picture below. From now on zlib and libpng are changed from dynamics linking to static linking for less dependencies errors.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25288195/5255835d929beebc27c063fa33ba493e6136df56.png

We would like to thank all Linux players for their understanding and patience. Update #68 should be released at end of next week.

notes.title: Update #64
notes.notes:
Our plan was to release 27 retro tables, and in Update 64, we have released the last few retro tables. Since Top Hand table has been released, we are happy to announce that all the tables we planned from the Zaccaria pinball company are now implemented.

We will announce soon what new features and tables we are working on and what to expect in the future. Meanwhile we are also working on the Nintendo Switch version and looking to release the game on new platforms.

We would like to thank for your support by purchasing of Gold or Platinum Pack. As a gratitude 27 free retro tables have been added to these packs. We hope this has been appealed to your enjoy. If you still want to support us please write a review of your opinion. Thank you!

Don’t forget to follow our Facebook page for global news, sweepstakes and other interesting information.

notes.title: Update #61
notes.notes:
Here is a new update with 5 new tables. Also with a surprise that would be a gift for you!

This is not a usual update since huge developments have been happened in the engine.
Because of that performance issue can be happaned.

ZP used 1 core so far, now it uses multicore that affects on loading, physics, sounds and script handling. This modification brought you faster running and some small improvements. This step had to be done because of console builds, like Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, iOS, Android, to run the same build on all of them and they will have the same updates.

Here are additional features of this update:

1. Artwork Editor
This mode includes a table with 2 differences.

The 1st difference:
The table has similar rules as other Zaccaria table but you collect extra coins that can be spent for customization items. You can edit artworks of the playfield and the covers and you can place together artworks of the table this way by an in-built editor. Here you can use your imagination and do that you have not do anywhere else.

The 2nd difference:
Everybody who purchases this mode will be a participant of a sweepstake where you can win a palpable gift. 5 pieces of handmade Mini Pinball model scaled 1/12 (made from wood, plexi and stainless steel, by sublimation printing, sticker-free) will be raffled in 1 month later.

notes.title: Update #46 - Sponsored by Easter Bunny
notes.notes:
Easter Bunny has been here and brought 2 Easter eggs. One of them includes a new modern table, Circus 2017. Unfortunately the other egg had a crack so it brings an online multiplayer option with beta version.

Circus 2017
The speciality of this table brings a new kind of challenge to ZP players. You have 2 balls at every round. Depending on your pinball skills you are able to complete all modes with 2 balls even.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25288195/6d1d90766aac875768b525b2139f72729cfbf652.png

http://store.steampowered.com/app/623790

Online Multiplayer
This feature is in very alpha stage, so issues can be happend for sure! This mode supports up to 4 players on Time Machine and all unlocked tables (free mode is not supported on those tables). Players are coming one after another and the order is defined by number of their SteamIDs.

We wish you a Happy Easter!

notes.title: Progress Update #1
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for your positive and negative feedback of our pinball game!

Every player who has membership, or a free player and is satisfied progression of our pinball game, please write a review. All feedback is important to us!

We have organized topics on Community Hub but they need continuous maintenance. We would choose 2 active players to be a moderator and help our work this way too.

We are about to start to work on a new kind of game mode that's not affected to the base game, but it would be strange for you firstly. We think this idea will be unique, entertaining and competitive. It has not been implemented by anyone so far, so we hope we will be able to do it successfully. More details will come shortly!
